---
title: "Multiple Contrasts & Hypothesis Representations"
description: "Research on multiple contrast procedures and representations of linear hypotheses."
---

I study structured multiple inference problems, with a particular interest in multiple contrast procedures and in how different representations of the same hypothesis can influence statistical inference.

Different matrices may represent the same scientific hypothesis while interacting differently with quadratic-form-based procedures. This creates both statistical and computational questions, including opportunities to reduce unnecessary complexity.

## Related Work

- Sattler, Pauly & Munko (2026), *Quadratic form based multiple contrast tests for comparison of group means*
- Sattler & Rosenbaum (2025), *Choice of the hypothesis matrix for using the Anova-type-statistic*
- Sattler & Zimmermann (2024), *Choice of the hypothesis matrix for using the Wald-type-statistic*
- [HypoShrink](../software/hyposhrink.qmd)
